budget.cost_source: Authenticated Featherless model-detail pricing and completion usage fields.

execution_amendment_after_invalid_glm_ru.evidence_trigger: In the first live bakeoff, every GLM-5.3 and GLM-5.3-Flash call reached the original 220-token ceiling with finish_reason=length and no parseable JSON. Those outputs are treated as invalid transport evidence, not model-action evidence.
execution_amendment_after_invalid_glm_ru.scope: Execution-format correction only. No model identities, prompts, temperature, selection dates, scoring rules, promotion gates, company-news veto, candidate policies, or holdout dates change.

fallback_architecture: Cloudflare Llama authoritative production adjudicator -> Featherless GLM independent shadow/model-risk observer -> deterministic agreement/disagreement audit -> zero Featherless execution authority.

information_boundary.market_data: Only values available by the frozen ClockCross decision boundary are supplied.
information_boundary.news: Retrospective Alpaca REST news is not fed into model selection because the existing Sep-3 fidelity investigation found it did not reproduce the live MCP decision or accepted aggregate. Models receive an explicit directional-research boundary telling them not to infer company-specific news. Timestamp-capped REST news may be collected only as holdout diagnostic metadata, and the recorded Sep-3 live company-news veto remains non-overridable.

model_rule: No substitution. Non-active, plan-ineligible, missing, or request-rejected models are recorded as unavailable; gated models may be attempted when the authenticated plan reports them available.

promotion_gates.holdout_rule: After selecting a winner without holdout access, the three Sep 1-3 policy returns must have mean candidate return >= mean incumbent return; Sep 2 remains a deterministic threshold abstain and the recorded Sep 3 company-news veto is non-overridable.

protocol_refinement_before_first_feather: Historical raw-news payloads were removed from model input before the first Featherless request, based on the already-preserved 2026-09-03 adaptive-regime finding that retrospective REST news was not a faithful production-context replay. This narrows the experiment to directional model quality and preserves the live news veto rather than scoring an invalid counterfactual.
purpose: Test whether a Featherless adjudication policy improves ClockCross without hindsight leakage before any production authority change.

scoring.primary: per-signal policy return difference versus incumbent, with abstain represented as zero exposure; paired 95% bootstrap CI

strategy_policy_frozen.reasoning_mode: disabled_via_chat_template_kwargs_enable_thinking_false; GLM rerun additionally requests reasoning_effort=low per execution amendment
